text: The only people who never fail are those who never try.
Imagination is more important than knowledge.
The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
The mind that is anxious about future events is miserable.
It is hard to fail, but it is worse never to have tried to succeed.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act but a habit.
Life is what happens when you are busy making other plans.
You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people just exist.
The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
Not all those who wander are lost. All that is gold does not glitter.
A friend is someone who knows all about you and still loves you.
It is never too late to be what you might have been.
Only a life lived for others is a life worthwhile.
Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
Injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
In three words I can sum up life: it goes on.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
The greatest wealth is to live content with little.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
I have not failed. I've just found ten thousand ways that won't work. One failed experiment is one step closer to success.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity. Look deep into nature, and then you will understand everything better. Never lose a holy curiosity.
The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today. Let us move forward with strong and active faith.
Do not anticipate trouble or worry about what may never happen. Keep in the sunlight. Count your life by smiles, not tears.
Live in each season as it passes; breathe the air, drink the drink, taste the fruit, and resign yourself to the influences of each.
The difference between a successful person and others is not a lack of strength, not a lack of knowledge, but rather a lack in will.
The whole problem with the world is that fools and fanatics are always so certain of themselves, but wiser people so full of doubts.
Most 'impossible' goals can be met simply by breaking them down into bite-size chunks, writing them down, believing them, and then going full speed ahead as if they were routine.
Keep away from people who try to belittle your ambitions. Small people always do that, but the really great make you feel that you, too, can become great.
Keep on going, and the chances are that you will stumble on something, perhaps when you are least expecting it. I never heard of anyone ever stumbling on something sitting down.

To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment. Be who you are and say what you feel, because those who mind don't matter, and those who matter don't mind.

Don't waste your life in doubts and fears: Spend yourself on the work before you, well assured that the right performance of this hour's duties will be the best preparation for the hours or ages that follow it.

Never, never, never, never, in nothing great or small, large or petty, never give in except to convictions of honour and good sense. Never yield to force; never yield to the apparently overwhelming might of the enemy.

Twenty years from now, you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do, so throw off the bowlines, sail away from safe harbor, catch the trade winds in your sails. Explore, Dream, Discover.

Would you like me to give you a formula for success? It's quite simple, really: Double your rate of failure. You are thinking of failure as the enemy of success. But it isn't at all. You can be discouraged by failure or you can learn from it, so go ahead and make mistakes. Make all you can. Because remember that's where you will find success.

Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined. As you simplify your life, the laws of the universe will be simpler. Solitude is not measured by the hours you spend alone.
